I am a 41-year-old farmer in Lilongwe with only 0.17 hectares for my maize, so I must make the most of every piece of land. I will use the fertilizer coupons I receive through the government program because without that subsidy I could never afford the bags myself, and I have some manure from my goats that I will also put on the plot to help the soil. I will plant the improved maize seed that came with the subsidy package, but I will not waste money on pesticides for food crops or try to irrigate when the rains are coming. My wife and children will do all the work on this small plot since it is not big enough to need paid workers.
